limitations: Evidence class: software verification of the extension registry (admission, identity, discovery, operations) against independent expectations: MODEL_BASES (never read by the generator), F0's M9 set, brute-force D5, hashlib recomputations. Status is tested, not reviewed: no reviewed status is claimed by the build lane; the review block stays pending.
Requirements empty: F1 maps to no D/A requirement; it is a 0.5 foundation package (target architecture section 3, ADR 0060).

E-F1-5 is shown on Linux x86-64 here and on both CI legs (run 43027599928, ubuntu-latest and ubuntu-24.04-arm); the X07a legs (Windows, macOS) are pending until those legs exist (ADR 0060 risk 7); LF normalisation of the self-hash makes the value independent of checkout line endings.

N4 (F1 review): implementation.modules paths are compared exact-case; on a case-insensitive file system (macOS, Windows) a wrong-case path resolves where Linux quarantines it with self_hash_unavailable.
N5 (F1 review): a zip or frozen build has no files under the built-in import root, so the built-in self-hashes cannot be computed and the process registry fails to build.

SF-8 trusts the digest for descriptor_problem only: a change to descriptor_problem's own code is outside table_sha256, and is caught by registry_builtin.py --check, which validates in full, in CI. Tokens, limitation codes, normalisation and self-hashes run for every table.

The predicted digests of the follow-up (f251447d..., 18fab1d2..., 3e69d0c7...) were computed with the code under test; they are regression expectations, not independent validation of the registry's hashing (E-F1-5 and E-F1-8 bear that).

No local full gate (scripts/gate.sh) was run; the default-marker suite ran once at a423093f in a clean worktree (20175 passed, 107 skipped, 220 deselected, 3 xfailed, 1 warning in 4569.58s (1:16:09)); the merge condition is CI green on both architectures, met by run 43027599928 (CLAUDE.md gate by risk).

Provenance: the manifest commit is a423093f; the CI run and the full suite ran there. The other local commands ran at b37ba8ff, which differs from a423093f only in scripts/t07_schema_fixtures.py (the $ref lookup sorts the schema files and skips non-objects; at b37ba8ff two tests in tests/test_t07_w3e_solution_state.py failed by directory order in a clean worktree, and at a423093f they pass: 76 passed, and the fixtures script exits 0 in a clean worktree).
